prose: The Wall Street Journal's take on the same filing: Oracle is selling $10 billion in common stock and $10 billion in bonds as it races to finance data-center construction and chip purchases, with the shares falling more than 5% on the news. The WSJ framing emphasizes the rush - Oracle is tapping equity and debt simultaneously while its credit metrics deteriorate toward junk territory.
highlights: WSJ confirms the $10B stock + $10B bond sale and the 5%+ share drop
Journal angle: the financing rush itself is the story, alongside the buildout it funds
